Results.ReviewText:
Amazing grill that I would recommend for anyone looking into getting into grilling more or just who needs an update! Great power, I'm never worried about what it can take. Tt's seen harsh winters and still powers on for every summer barbeque. Makes great food every time and is super easy to use. If you treat it well and clean it as needed this grill will last the test of time. 

Quick note: After three years of not taking great care of the grill I noticed the flavorizer bars began to rust through. I can assure you if you take care of this grill this will not happen but if you are worried about it I would buy a better flavorizer bar set. none the less te rest of the box way good as new!

Results.ReviewText: Works great. Gets very hot which makes it perfect for searing meat. I previously had the E210 but decided to upgrade so as to have more surface area for cooking. The two side tables are just the right size for holding plates and grilling tools while I grill.

Results.ReviewText: This is my 4th 3 burner Weber that I have purchased during my 40+ years of grilling. This grill will be used at our new northern Michigan cottage. I grill 200+ times a year in Michigan and the Weber holds its temperature better than any other grill that I have used. The grill warranty is second to none although I have only needed to use it one time over the 40 years. That Weber is still in use at my sons house and is about 20 years old. Thank you Weber.
Results.Title: Durability and reliability

Results.ReviewText: great grill easy to use and food tastes great this is the second one I've owned first one lasted 25 years can't go wrong with a weber
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText:
The reason I have bought only Weber grills for the past fifty years is the most obvious one.  It is the top of the line in quality, service, and dependability.  I have owned four of these grills, all with 10-year warranties.  EVERY part that was still under warranted was replaced when they rusted or malfunctioned.  ALSO...you get qualified customer service personnel who can answer any question and and help you with installing the replacement parts.  Several times, agents have talked me through the process.  I am not handy with tools, nor am I good at reading and following printed directions.  Their representatives can help with all of that.  I have been 100% percent satisfied with every Weber product I have ever purchased.  That includes their grilling tools, grill covers, etc.  I would not own any other grill than a Weber.  You cannot beat the performance of the grills, and you sure can't beat the solid delivery on warranty.  No questions asked.  Try a Weber, and you will not want anything else!  
And may I take this opportunity to thank the many Weber facilitators who have helped me all of these years with any and every problem I have ever had!
Results.Title: Weber is the BEST.  Don't settle for SECOND BEST!

Results.ReviewText: Easy to assemble and cooks great...like all webers

46510001.Name: Spirit E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
